name: Underdrown
source:
1928, Estonia, Arumere, Near Parnu.

A small, northern village, on the shore of the Baltic Sea. A small rural school, overlooking the beach. The main character, instead of studying, prefers to look at the northern sea.

But one day, he saw something strange...

Something that should not be there...

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/underdrown]itch.io[/url]]
